name: delivery-kit
description: Three plugins for long Claude Code sessions: hand the work off before the context runs out, drive one feature from idea to reviewed pull request, and run a team's plan through that pipeline.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Warns before a session runs out of context, then writes a handoff document the next session resumes from in a single file read.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Takes one feature from idea to reviewed pull request — spec, plan, build, review, ship — stopping to ask you at every step that leaves your machine. Requires spec-kit in the target repository.

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Runs a team's plan through the pipeline: set up the team once, then each member starts their next task with one command, and progress is kept for the team leader.
